findings.issue: en adds a mode of travel absent from the JP: つきました only means 'arrived', and the token glosses つく as 'to arrive'. 'Flew in' teaches a false equivalence (pt correctly has 'chegar').
findings.current: I just flew in on business.

findings.issue: expl_pt inserts a level claim 'padrão N3' that is absent from expl_en and contradicts the item's own level (n4); ことになっている is standardly listed as N4. Inconsistent between language versions.
findings.current: Aqui aparece o padrão N3 ～ことになっている (e não ことにしている)
findings.suggested: Aqui aparece o padrão ～ことになっている (e não ことにしている)

findings.issue: Glitched duplicated gloss: 'this morning / this morning'. The pt counterpart has two distinct renderings ('esta manhã / hoje de manhã'); the en repeats the same one twice.
findings.current: 今朝 ('this morning / this morning') sets the time
findings.suggested: 今朝 ('this morning') sets the time

findings.issue: Stray authoring metadata sentence in learner-facing text ('Target is N4 coverage.'), which also contradicts the item's level tag (n3). Same leak exists in expl_pt ('O alvo é cobertura N4.').
findings.suggested: (delete this sentence; also delete 'O alvo é cobertura N4.' from expl_pt)

findings.issue: Untranslated Japanese jargon 動詞 used for 'verb' in the pt-BR beginner explanation; expl_en says 'past-form verb'. Should be 'verbo'.
findings.current: A frase usa 動詞 (forma passada) + わけではない
findings.suggested: A frase usa verbo (forma passada) + わけではない

findings.issue: The に of ように is labeled 'auxiliar', contradicting the token's own gloss '(partícula de ように)'; に is a particle, and 'auxiliar' is reserved for ます/た/いる in this corpus.
